zh.title: 法國疾風戰機巡航發現商務機漏油 龐巴迪機改降巴黎
zh.summary: 龐巴迪商務機於法國上空右翼洩漏燃油；疾風戰機通報後改降巴黎
body: 法國空暨太空軍一架疾風（Rafale）戰機於2026年8月12日執行訓練任務時，在4萬英呎高空發現一架龐巴迪（Bombardier）Global 6000商務機右翼洩漏燃油。該商務機隨後放棄飛往美國邁阿密的跨大西洋航程，改降法國巴黎勒布爾熱機場（LBG）。
根據法國航空防禦與航空行動司令部（CDAOA）說明，該架疾風戰機自蒙德馬桑118空軍基地起飛執行訓練任務。飛行員在巡航高度會合時目視發現該機右翼洩漏燃油並聞到航空煤油氣味，隨即通報該機機組人員。
機組人員接獲警報後向航管報告情況，並轉向改降巴黎勒布爾熱機場（CIA）。公開航班追蹤資料顯示，該架註冊號N1244的商務機登記於Leon Global Express名下，當日原預計自羅馬錢皮諾機場飛往邁阿密。

en.title: French Rafale Intercepts Bombardier Global 6000 Over France After Spotting Fuel Leak
en.summary: A Bombardier Global 6000 diverted to Paris after a French Rafale pilot spotted a fuel leak.
body: A French Air and Space Force Rafale fighter pilot detected a fuel leak on a Bombardier Global 6000 business jet at 40,000 feet over France on August 12, 2026. The discovery prompted the crew to abort a transatlantic flight to Miami and divert to Paris-Le Bourget Airport (LBG), according to France's Air Defense and Air Operations Command (CDAOA).

The Rafale had launched from Air Base 118 Mont-de-Marsan for a training mission. Upon joining the Global 6000 at cruising altitude, the pilot noticed a dissipate trail beside the aircraft's standard contrails, registered a smell of kerosene, and identified fuel escaping from the business jet's right wing.

After being alerted, the business jet crew reported the situation to air traffic control and turned toward Le Bourget. Tracking data indicates the aircraft, registered N1244 to Leon Global Express, had departed Rome Ciampino Airport (CIA) for Miami before diverting.
